title: Vegetable Samosa
description: Crisp, deep-fried pastry parcels filled with spiced mashed potato and peas — the classic teatime snack.

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.notes: 2 tbsp for the dough, rest for frying

steps: Mix the flour, 2 tbsp oil, carom seeds and salt. Add water gradually and knead into a firm, smooth dough. Cover and rest for 20-30 minutes.
For the filling, heat a little oil in a pan and add cumin seeds. Once they sizzle, add the ginger and green chillies, and sauté briefly.
Add the green peas and cook for 2-3 minutes, then add the mashed potato, coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala, amchur and salt to taste. Mix well and let it cool.
Divide the dough into 6 balls. Roll each into an oval, cut in half to make two semicircles per ball.
Shape each semicircle into a cone, sealing the straight edge with a little water. Fill with 2 tablespoons of the potato mixture, then seal the top edge to close the samosa.
Heat oil in a deep pan to medium-low (a piece of dough should rise slowly, not sizzle immediately). Fry the samosas in batches for 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until deep golden and crisp.
Drain on a paper towel and serve hot with mint or tamarind chutney.
